result.brief: 提出将分布匹配蒸馏重构为对抗蒸馏（DMAD），用共享骨干上的判别器头直接学习对数密度比，无需辅助扩散模型拟合，实现少步视觉生成；在ImageNet-64、SDXL、Wan2.1-T2V-14B视频生成及MiniMax-H3联合音视频生成上取得领先的少步结果。
result.reason: Recasts DMD as adversarial distillation for few-step visual generation, with four-step Wan2.1 video and joint audio-video generation results, directly serving video and audio-video generation efficiency.
